reasoning_content: Now tex2pdf. The src/api and src/core reference `../../../../03-shared-services/bizlog` relative to src/api => /03-shared-services/bizlog in container. But Dockerfile doesn't copy 03-shared-services. So this is a pre-existing breakage. Let me add the copy and rewrite paths.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/build_tex2pdf.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
SVC=tex2pdf-service
CTX=/tmp/g_tex2pdf-service
SRC=/workspace/02-backend/$SVC
rm -rf "$CTX"; mkdir -p "$CTX"
cp -r "$SRC"/. "$CTX"/
rm -rf "$CTX/.git"
cp -r /workspace/03-shared-services "$CTX/03-shared-services"
# top-level bizlog path ../../03-shared-services -> 03-shared-services
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./\.\./03-shared-services/|path = "03-shared-services/|g' "$CTX/pyproject.toml"
# src/api & src/core: ../../../../03-shared-services -> ../../03-shared-services relative to /app/src/api -> /app/03-shared-services? 
# In container, pyproject at /app/src/api; ../../../../ = / outside. We want /app/03-shared-services => "../../../03-shared-services"
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./\.\./\.\./\.\./03-shared-services/|path = "../../../03-shared-services/|g' "$CTX"/src/*/pyproject.toml
# Insert COPY in every WORKDIR /app stage
awk '{print} /^WORKDIR \/app[[:space:]]*$/ {print "COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/"}' "$CTX/Dockerfile" > "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" && mv "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" "$CTX/Dockerfile"
cd "$CTX"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f uv.lock
uv lock >/tmp/lock_tex2pdf.log 2>&1 || { echo LOCKFAIL; tail -8 /tmp/lock_tex2pdf.log; exit 3; }
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 timeout 590 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN -t tex2pdf-service . 
SH
chmod +x /tmp/build_tex2pdf.sh
/tmp/build_tex2pdf.sh > /tmp/build_tex2pdf2.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -8 /tmp/build_tex2pdf2.log
